newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms vs dollar, weakens vs stg.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms vs dollar, weakens vs stg.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against the dollar and weakened against sterling on Thursday reflecting international market trends, forex dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a commercial mean rate of 20.4165 to the dollar from 20.4445 on Wednesday and at a commercial mean rate of 33.583 to sterling from 33.364 on Wednesday.
Local commercial banks were also short dollars in anticipation that the central bank would sell dollars, as it did earlier this week, dealers said.
